item: The Core-only job lists its skips with -rfEs, and scripts/preflight.sh stops claiming the test job's EXACT commands; a test pins both
summary: Core-only's pytest step is python -m pytest -q -rfEs like the test job's (-r replaces pytest's default fE, so -rs alone would hide FAILED/ERROR names; found by the #1663 read), so its skip file/line/reason block is in its log. scripts/preflight.sh said it ran the test job's EXACT commands but ran pytest -q without the job's flags and omitted most of the job's steps: the header now says ruff-correctness and mypy are verbatim, pytest is the job's without -rfEs (a bare sandbox skips hundreds of tests and that block would bury the failures the advisory run is read for), and names what is not run; the closing line no longer says Safe to push. tests/test_ci_pytest_flags_and_preflight.py pins the flags of both jobs and preflight's three commands against ci.yml, with six mutants that must be named; red before on the unedited files (the two real tests fail), green after. Stated limit: the Core-only skip block was not read from a runner log (the log tail tool returns ~13 KB), and preflight.sh was run end to end WITHOUT --tests (ruff and mypy gates passed, exit 0), so its --tests branch was only syntax-checked (bash -n).
